error_description.description: Optional field used to return a sentence or two at most describing the circumstance of the error (must be ASCII).

error_uri.description: Optional field that can be used to link to documentation for information about how to correct the specific error.

state.description:
OAuth 2.0 state value. REQUIRED if the Authorization Request included the state parameter. Set to the value
received from the Client.

title: Error responses are returned with an HTTP 400 status code (unless specified otherwise), with error and error_description parameters.
name: OidcErrorResponse
